documentation overlay only - not asset - not app screen - not engine-ready
Decision: use as overlay planning reference.
Not a pixel target, not asset, not engine-ready.
Next: external layer brief after overlay approval.
M16-CR uses the M16-CP 1x bitmap only as documentation background. Overlays are planning geometry; no runtime anchors, no separate transparent layers, no assets under assets/.
